lead.event: Singapore reports record Q3 non-oil domestic export growth
lead.headline: Singapore reports record 45.8% Q3 growth in non-oil domestic exports
lead.blurb: Electronics NODX climbed 117%, following 88.1% growth in Q2, while non-electronics exports rose 20.8%. Enterprise Singapore attributed the record to mainly AI-related demand for electronics and specialised machinery. NODX grew 27.6% in the first three quarters.

deals_control.event: StarHub and Keppel agree M1 merger and Circles Life acquisition
deals_control.headline: StarHub agrees S$1.06 billion M1 merger with Keppel and Circles Life acquisition
deals_control.blurb: StarHub will issue about 651.7 million shares at an implied S$1.04 each and take on up to S$380 million of M1 net debt. M1 will become a wholly owned subsidiary, with completion expected in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.

deals_control.event: Marco Polo Marine seeks shareholder approval for shipyard spin-off and listing
deals_control.headline: Marco Polo Marine seeks approval for shipyard spin-off and listing in deal worth up to S$139 million
deals_control.blurb: Shareholders will vote at an extraordinary general meeting on 10 December on three resolutions, all of which must pass. Fuji Offset Plates Manufacturing will pay up to S$139 million in new shares for the shipyard business, reducing Marco Polo Marine’s effective interest from 100% to about 74.1%, or about 76.8% if all deferred shares are issued; completion remains conditional.

deals_control.event: Stoneweg European Stapled Trust acquires Verona logistics facility
deals_control.headline: Stoneweg Europe Stapled Trust acquires Verona logistics facility for EUR61 million
deals_control.blurb: The newly completed, 43,500-square-metre freehold facility is fully leased to Stora Enso for 15 years and has a net initial yield of about 6%. The price was about 7% below its EUR65.7 million independent valuation, lifting the trust’s logistics, light industrial and data-centre exposure to 63.8%. The trust is targeting close to 80% exposure to those assets by 2028.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Sembcorp-linked Taweelah C project reaches financial close
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Sembcorp-linked Taweelah C reaches financial close on AED 7.76 billion project
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: TAQA holds 60% of the project company, with Sembcorp and Saudi Arabia's Al Jomaih Energy and Water Company holding the remaining 40% through a consortium. The 2.6 GW gas-fired plant is expected to begin commercial operations in 2029.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: US AI chip export controls prompt Natixis warning and bank reviews
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: US chip controls prompt bank reviews as Natixis cites Asean banks’ 31 per cent loan share
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: DBS, OCBC and UOB are seeking chip-use details and compliance proof from data centre clients under new US licensing rules. Lenders froze a US$480 million loan intended to fund Nvidia hardware for ByteDance.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Manulife US REIT reaches lender agreement to exit restructuring
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Manulife US REIT reaches proposed lender deal to exit restructuring, US$3m yearly cap
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The lender proposal would extend loan maturities by about 12 to 18 months, excluding the sponsor-lender loan, and allow half-yearly distributions capped at the lower of 20 per cent of annual distributable income or US$3 million a year. Unitholders will vote at an extraordinary general meeting on 15 December 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: China Vanke seeks extension on bond payment
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: China Vanke seeks three-year extension on 1.2 billion yuan bond
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The proposal would defer principal due 15 December while paying the 3% coupon on time, according to people familiar with the matter. Vanke has also discussed upfront principal payments of less than half the 40% offered in its January extension deal.

other.event: Boeing receives Xiamen Airlines order for 50 737-8 Max jets
other.headline: Boeing receives Xiamen Airlines order for 50 737-8 Max jets worth US$7.4 billion
other.blurb: The order is from a unit of China Southern Airlines and is Boeing’s biggest order from Chinese airlines since 2017. It follows China’s May commitment to buy 200 planes, while a previously discussed 500-jet agreement has not been formalised.

market_structure_policy.event: Singapore and China expand RMB financing and explore payment linkage
market_structure_policy.headline: Singapore and China expand RMB financing and explore payment linkage
market_structure_policy.blurb: The MAS RMB Facility will be restructured into corporate financing for trade with third countries, working capital and capital expenditure, plus a liquidity backstop. Eligible collateral will expand to include Singapore Government Securities and MAS bills, with China Government Bonds potentially added. DBS is starting renminbi clearing services, and Bank of China's Singapore branch is becoming an MAS Primary Dealer.

market_structure_policy.headline: US proposes tariffs of up to 20% on Singapore goods
market_structure_policy.blurb: The proposal would lift the effective tariff rate on Singapore exports to the US from 7.8% to 10.3%, affecting about S$9.4 billion of exports. The rate could fall to 10% if Singapore reaches an Agreement on Reciprocal Trade or concludes other negotiations addressing the findings, with written comments due by 5 January 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: US announces new Section 301 tariff plans on major trading partners
market_structure_policy.headline: US plans Section 301 tariffs of up to 20% on Singapore
market_structure_policy.blurb: Proposed rates include 20% for China, potentially rising to 40%; 15% for the EU, Japan, South Korea and Switzerland; and 17% for India. The tariffs face public comment, with final action possible as early as January, and will not stack with existing forced-labour-related duties of 10% or 12.5%, as only the higher rate applies.

earnings_guidance.event: Hongkong Land raises 2026 earnings guidance and DBS responds
earnings_guidance.headline: Hongkong Land raises FY2026 profit guidance to mid-teens growth as DBS maintains Buy
earnings_guidance.blurb: The company now expects a mid-teens percentage rise in underlying profit and high-teens growth in earnings per share, supported by its share buyback programme. DBS Group Research maintained its Buy rating with a US$10.08 target price, against a closing price of US$8.46. Hongkong Land’s US$750 million buyback programme has been extended to February 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Seatrium analysts react to Q3 business update
earnings_guidance.headline: Analysts split on Seatrium as order book falls to S$12.2 billion after Q3 update
earnings_guidance.blurb: CGS International downgraded Seatrium to hold and cut its target to S$1.80 from S$2.60, while UOB Kay Hian kept hold and lowered its target to S$1.80 from S$2.30. DBS Group Research and OCBC retained buy calls, citing margin recovery and steady execution. Seatrium reported S$1.7 billion in new orders this year, with deliveries extending to 2033.

earnings_guidance.event: Riverstone Holdings reports Q3 recovery and analyst forecast revisions
earnings_guidance.headline: Riverstone reports Q3 profit up 34.7% as UOB Kay Hian raises forecasts
earnings_guidance.blurb: UOB Kay Hian lifted FY2026–28 earnings forecasts by 11.1%–14.9% to RM242.0–278.3 million but cut its target price from S$1.21 to S$1.08, using a lower 19x FY2027 valuation multiple. Riverstone expects new facilities to lift cleanroom capacity by 10%–15% by 1Q2027.

earnings_guidance.event: DBS cuts its target price for Frencken Group
earnings_guidance.headline: DBS cuts Frencken Group target price to S$2.58
earnings_guidance.blurb: DBS maintained its Buy call, lowering the target from S$3.76 after Frencken’s Q3 FY2026 results broadly met expectations. It cited the enlarged share base after the rights issue and a lower valuation multiple of 23 times FY2027 expected earnings, down from 35 times.

macro_flows.event: Singapore raises its 2026 GDP growth forecast
macro_flows.headline: Singapore raises 2026 GDP growth forecast to around 6%
macro_flows.blurb: The upgrade replaces the 4.5% to 5.5% range set in August, with strong global AI-related demand cited. Q3 GDP growth was revised to 6.1% year on year from 5.4%, while the 2027 forecast is 2.5% to 4.5% as AI investment moderates.
